facts.fact: Roughly 88% of US households own at least one internet-connected TV device, according to the StackAdapt article.
facts.quote: Roughly [88% of US households](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/connected-tv-stats) now own at least one internet-connected TV device

facts.fact: According to the StackAdapt article, CTV accounts for over one-third of total TV usage.
facts.quote: CTV accounts for over one-third of total TV usage.

facts.fact: The global viewability rate of CTV ads reached 93.2% in the first half of 2022, per Statista as cited in the article.
facts.quote: In the first half of 2022, the global viewability rate of CTV ads reached [93.2%]

facts.fact: According to IAS, over 90% of CTV ad impressions meet the MRC viewability standards.
facts.quote: According to IAS, over [90% of CTV](https://www.theviewpoint.com/insights/reasons-why-ad-viewability-measurement-matters) ad impressions meet the MRC viewability standards

facts.fact: A measured CTV viewability rate of 93.3% is cited from a WARC source in the article.
facts.quote: with a measured viewability rate of [93.3%]

facts.fact: The article states CTV viewability remains in the low 90s, citing MarketingCharts.
facts.quote: While CTV viewability remains in the [low 90s]

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that CTV ads naturally lead to exceptional viewability rates, often close to 100%.
facts.quote: This naturally leads to exceptional viewability rates, often close to 100%.

facts.fact: The Media Rating Council (MRC) sets minimum standards for what counts as a viewable impression in digital advertising.
facts.quote: The MRC sets minimum standards for what counts as a viewable impression in digital advertising.

facts.fact: CTV ads are delivered to viewers through internet-connected devices including smart TVs, streaming devices, gaming consoles, and set-top boxes.
facts.quote: CTV ads are delivered to viewers through internet-connected devices, including smart TVs, streaming devices (e.g., Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV), gaming consoles, and set-top boxes.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt article was published on February 18, 2025.
StackAdapt's blog states that many streaming platforms do not allow viewers to skip ads, so ads are fully viewed.
facts.quote: Many streaming platforms do not allow skipping ads, ensuring that ads are fully viewed.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that Disney+ displays countdown timers on ads so viewers can anticipate ad duration.
facts.quote: For example, Disney+ displays countdown timers on ads, helping viewers anticipate ad duration and stay engaged.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that CTV ads play in full-screen mode, one ad at a time, without scrolling or minimized tabs.
facts.quote: CTV ads play in full-screen mode, ensuring total visibility. There’s no scrolling, minimized tabs, or distractions
